scripts.build: dart compile js -O2 -o lib/bundle.js bin/index.dart && node bin/node-preamble.js lib/bundle.js > lib/index.js
scripts.watch: dart compile js -O1 -o lib/bundle.js bin/index.dart && node bin/node-preamble.js lib/bundle.js > lib/index.js
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
